m: अ-व्रात्य m. not a Vratya, AV. xv, 13, 6
अ-व्रात्य n. = अ-व्रत्य n. q.v., Viṣṇus.

v: tri॰ nAsti vraRo'sya । 1 vraRaSUnye vraRaSca kzatAdi “tatrAdO dantapavanaM dvAdaSANgulamAyatam । kanizWikAparIRAhamfjvagrAyatamavraRam” suSru॰ 2 netrarogamede “yat savraRaM SukramaTAvraRaM vA pAkAtyayaScApyajakA taTEva । catvAra ete'BihitA vikArAH kfzRASrayAH saMgrahataH purastAt” iti viBajya, tallakzmApyukta suSrute “sitaM yadA BAtyasitapradeSe syandAtmakaM nAtirugaSruyuktam । vihAyasIvABradalAnukAri tadavraRaM sADyatamaM vadanti” “anenApaharecCukramavraRaM kuSaloBizak” suSru॰ ।
m: अ-व्रण mf(आ)n. unhurt, unscarred, sound, VS. xl, 8; BhP.
(generally said of bows, swords, sticks &c.) without rents or splinters or notches, entire, KātyŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: अव्रण — a. Without wounds or scars or rents, unhurt, sound. --णं One of the four diseases of the eye.

v: tri॰ nAsti vrataM vihitaniyamo yasya । SAstravihita niyamaSUnye “avratAnAsamantrARAM jAtimAtropajIvinAm । nEzAM pratigrahodeyo na SilA tArayecCilAm” manuH ।
m: अ-व्रत mf(आ)n. lawless, disobedient, wicked, RV.; AV.; SV.
not observing religious rites or obligations, Gobh.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: अव्रत — a. Not observing (the prescribed) religious rites or obligations; अव्रतानाममंत्राणां जातिमात्रोपजीविनामासहस्रशः समेतानां परिषत्त्वं न विद्यते .. Ms. 12. 114; 3. 170; 10. 20.

m: अ-व्रत—वत् mfn. not observing religious rites, MBh. xii, 2305.
अ-व्रतिक mfn. = अव्रत-वत्, q.v., MBh. xii, 1336.
अ-व्रतिन् mfn. id., MBh. xiii, 1601; R.

v: tri॰ vratAya hitam yat na॰ ta॰ । vratakAleanAcaraRIye'nftakaTanAdO “avrataM vA vyAharati tanmiTyA karoti vratam” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अ-व्रत्य अम्, n. anything out of harmony with, or violating, a religious obligation, ŚBr.; AitBr.; AitĀr.
अ-व्रत्य mfn. with कर्मन् id., Gobh.
a: अव्रत्यं — [व्रताय हितं, यत् न. त.] Violation of religious duties, offenceagainst the rule of an ascetic.

m: अव्रत्योपचार m. practising anything that offends one's religious obligations, ĀśvŚr.; ĀśvGṛ.
